**Metro and Bus Travel in Tbilisi to be Free for Easter Holiday**
14:24, 10.04.2026
 
In connection with the Easter holiday, the Tbilisi Metro will operate until 04:00 on April 12, and travel will be free from 23:00 on April 11 until 04:00 on April 12. The information was released by the Tbilisi City Hall.

Additionally, by decision of the capital's City Hall, nine temporary bus routes have been established for April 12-13.

"Buses will transport passengers from 08:00 to 20:00 in the direction of Mukhatgverdi, Vashlijvari, Kukia, New Kukia, Makhata, Saburtalo, Ghrmaghele, Veli, and Varketili cemeteries.

The buses will operate from the following metro stations: 'Marjanishvili', 'Delisi', 'Sarajishvili', the area surrounding 'Varketili', as well as from the upper exit of 'Didube', Station Square (opposite 'Tbilisi Central'), Besarion Chichinadze Street (opposite Building N25), and Varketili III Massif – from the intersection of Shuamta and Abashvili streets.

Citizens will be able to use the buses on these routes free of charge for two days," the Tbilisi City Hall information states.
